comment: Manual cards-tid → labs-tid overrides for tournaments where automatic name-matching fails. Used by backend/scrapers/tournament_scraper_JH.py (_resolve_labs_tournament_id) for new scrapes and by backend/scrapers/backfill_labs_tournament_id.py for historical overview rows. Cause of mismatch is in 'reason' for each entry. Add new entries when the limitlesstcg.com name diverges from the labs.limitlesstcg.com name in a way the normalize step can't bridge.

518.reason: NAIC 2026 abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship New Orleans' — same event 2026-06-10 (same city, same date, same event type; exactly the pattern of its 2025 sibling, cards 463 -> labs 0034). The name normaliser cannot bridge it: it strips 'international/championship/limitless' but nothing strips the acronym 'naic' or the year, so the keys are 'new orleans' vs 'naic 2026 new orleans'.

533.reason: limitless Spanish 'Sevilla' vs labs English 'Seville' — same event 2026-03-28

517.reason: EUIC abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship London' — same event 2026-02-13

516.reason: LAIC abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship São Paulo' — same event 2025-11-21

500.reason: Worlds 2025 — limitless 'World Championships 2025' vs labs 'World Championship Anaheim'

463.reason: NAIC 2025 abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship New Orleans' — same event 2025-06-13

462.reason: EUIC 2025 abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship London' — same event 2025-02-21

461.reason: LAIC 2024-25 abbreviation vs labs 'International Championship São Paulo' — same event 2024-11-15
